steps.what: Select classroom equipment and supplies and inventory current quantities and condition
Prepare order lines for the selected classroom equipment, materials and supplies
Check and submit the classroom order within delegated purchasing authority
Store and issue classroom equipment, materials and supplies and check physical stock movements

tasks.design: Configure order templates in {PROCUREMENT} using the teacher's checked stock and material selections from {SPREADSHEET}. The teacher retains selection, physical inventory, order checking, storage and issue; the change only removes repeated order-line preparation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teachers copied the same selected item and quantity details into purchasing forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native request templates can reuse explicit item fields without deciding what a classroom needs.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching suitability, condition and actual stock availability require human checking.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows what supports the lesson and notices unsuitable or damaged materials.
tasks.altitude: Less order-form filling; teaching choices and responsibility for materials remain unchanged.

reach.task: Match classroom resources to teaching requirements

evidence.claim: A native purchasing template can reuse checked item and quantity fields without choosing classroom resources; the proposed hours are unmeasured model scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's classroom resource selection, inventory, request preparation, storage and issue, excluding central purchasing approval, supplier fulfilment and payment processing. Each physical count and request must be owned once.

Teacher counts and checks stock and captures item identifier, description, current quantity and unit, condition, intended use, selected order quantity and unit, catalogue reference and delivery location in s1's 35 hours. Desired quantities are chosen by the teacher, not a free par-level field.

School purchasing staff maintain the existing supplier catalogue through normal work; additional template-field upkeep is counted below. s2 copies checked fields only. Missing codes, uncertain units or unsuitable catalogue matches return to manual request preparation in s3's retained 20 hours.

The existing purchasing role processes the submitted request after s3; suppliers deliver through unchanged work before s4 handles the new items. Existing stock can also be stored and issued in s4. Supplier and central purchasing time is not reduced or transferred.
Try native request templates first. s4 retains all physical handling and stock-movement capture in its 30 hours; no automatic resource suitability or receipt-completeness flag is assumed.
unknowns: Whether native request forms can reuse current stock fields
Which purchasing actions the teacher may authorize
How much order-line copying actually occurs
research_questions: Can a native template reduce request preparation without changing teacher selection, stock counting or physical issue work?

already_counted.description: Select and capture supply fields, check orders and physically store and issue materials

incremental.description: Maintain request templates and item-unit mappings
Maintain additional catalogue fields used by templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact submitted request, item identifiers, quantities and units, catalogue references and delivery location within delegated authority; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85, gross=15; subtract 6 focal upkeep for central net=9. Range assumes only repeat catalogue requests fit the template. Two other-role upkeep hours are recorded separately; all selection, stock checking and physical handling retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assist in the school library and monitor halls, cafeteria and bus loading and unloading

tasks.design: Keep school routine assistance and pupil supervision human, using current duty instructions in {DOCS} as needed. The teacher is present, responds to actual activity and helps pupils and colleagues during the assigned routines.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work requires physical presence and judgement about changing pupil and school needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native duty records already support the work; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: A nominal timetable cannot establish whether a pupil needs help or a transition is proceeding appropriately.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher notices confusion or distress and responds in context.
tasks.altitude: Routine assistance and supervision effort and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Support pupils during school routines and transitions

evidence.claim: Library assistance and pupil supervision require situated human help and presence; no labour saving is claimed from treating these as administrative paperwork.

assumptions: Boundary is carrying out assigned school routine duties, excluding creating the duty roster, teaching classes, specialist library cataloguing and bus driving. Shared supervision must have one owner.

School management supplies duty assignments and current procedures through existing work. Pupils and library users produce the observed needs during the duty; teacher observes, clarifies and captures issues within the retained 100 hours. No free structured safe-transition or pupil-needs flag is assumed.
Keep current native instructions and supervision practice. No camera, pupil classifier or new process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which duties are assigned locally and how much time each takes
How staff escalate pupil or transport concerns
research_questions: Are teachers clear about responsibility and escalation during each school routine?

already_counted.description: Provide routine school assistance, observe pupil activity and respond to needs

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental upkeep=0. Physical presence, assistance and supervision keep full effort; no clerical baseline or colleague time saving is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Some repeat order-line preparation may shrink, while classroom resource judgement, physical handling and pupil supervision retain full human time.
reach: Coordinate suitable resources with instructional coordinators
Learn transition support practices from teaching assistants
skills_to_grow: Capture item quantities and units consistently
Separate resource choice from purchasing form preparation
role.ambitious_version: Maintain suitable classroom resources with simpler requests while preserving the human presence required by school routines.
